name: Shopper
tagline: Takes the thinking out of buying.
description: Tell it what you want (a TV, groceries, anything) and it researches options from reviews, ratings, specs, and what it knows about you, then hunts the best price across Amazon, Costco, Instacart, Walmart, and any other store you sign in. It brings back the top two or three and waits before buying, until you trust a category enough to auto-buy. Pays with Link or a card already saved on the store.
author: Pete
notes: Native Grok Bot share link. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
